name: desk
description: Drive any desktop app and any website from an AI agent. One command, automatic fallback across agent-desktop, Cua Driver, agent-browser and Playwright. macOS, Windows, Linux, Web.

interface.shortDescription: Drive any desktop app and any website
interface.longDescription: desk gives Codex one command for GUI work: click, type, find and screenshot in native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux, and open, read and fill web pages. It routes to agent-desktop first and falls back to Cua Driver, and for the web to agent-browser, agent-reach and Playwright. Every action returns one JSON line naming the driver that did it, and desk never repeats an action that might already have landed.
defaultPrompt: Open Notes and create a new note that says hello from desk
